title: Bounded runtime-shard metrics verification
verification_method: MeterListener tests, shard scheduler and disposal regression tests, full QUIC tests, SpecTrace validation, and a source-backed ProtocolLab counter capture.
scope: Verify paired per-shard queue depth, bounded enqueue/dequeue dimensions, disabled-listener behavior, actual due-timer processing, and diagnostic artifact generation without protocol or scheduling changes.
preconditions: The existing Incursa.Quic Meter remains the only transport metrics surface.
Runtime-shard tags are bounded to shard_index and work_item_kind.
ProtocolLab diagnostics attach to the measured target process.
procedure: Observe one successful enqueue and dequeue and confirm depth returns to zero for the shard.
Confirm depth is tagged only by shard_index while work counters add bounded work_item_kind values.
Exercise timer wake and actual due-timer work through the shard consumer.
Confirm disposed or rejected enqueue attempts do not emit measurements.
Run the complete test and SpecTrace validation suites.
Capture and inspect a ProtocolLab runtime-shard summary from the target process.
expected_result: Shard diagnostics are balanced, bounded, attributable by shard and work kind, and observational only; ProtocolLab retains them as diagnostic evidence.
status_summary: Focused metrics and reflection-guard tests passed 9/9. The complete QUIC suite passed 9,443 tests with five skips and one unrelated DoQ lifecycle stress failure that passed immediately in isolation. Source-backed ProtocolLab run raw-incursa-shard-diagnostics-20260711a passed validation and benchmark execution, captured 1,044 shard samples without parse warnings, balanced enqueue/dequeue observations on all four shards, and retained the populated summary in the evidence bundle. The repository-wide SpecTrace validator remains baseline-blocked by 2,633 pre-existing errors; this artifact, its work item, and the updated architecture validate individually.
